_comment: Per-actor input templates. Placeholders in {braces} are filled at runtime:
{post_urls}  list of post URLs whose comments to fetch
Replace any block below to match the exact input schema of the actor you
configured in APIFY_*_ACTOR. Check the actor's own docs on apify.com — the
defaults here follow the field names the default actors document, but actor
input schemas do change and are the actor author's to define.
